title: Pure Star Warrior
summary: Iggy Arlo's (Kachidoki's) Star Warrior archetype is a Level 5 LIGHT and EARTH Warrior Fusion OTK deck centered around Kaiki the Unity Star, Hayate the Earth Star, Tenma the Sky Star, and their Level 10–12 Fusion bosses Idaten the Conqueror Star, Raijin the Breakbolt Star, and Shura the Combat Star! Special Summon Level 5 EARTH Warrior Hayate the Earth Star when you control no monsters (or while your opponent controls a monster), and it immediately Special Summons Level 5 LIGHT Warrior Tenma the Sky Star from your hand! Better yet, Feast of the Wild LV5 revives 2 Level 5 Warriors (including Kaiki the Unity Star!) from your GY, and when Kaiki the Unity Star is Special Summoned, you pay 500 LP to Fusion Summon Idaten the Conqueror Star without Polymerization—which searches another Level 5 Warrior on Fusion Summon, modifies its own ATK to trigger Kaiki's Quick-Effect GY revival on the opponent's turn, and fuses into the Level 12 boss Shura the Combat Star!

allow.Feast of the Wild LV5: Core Spell: Special Summons up to 2 Level 5 Warrior monsters (Kaiki the Unity Star, Hayate the Earth Star, or Tenma the Sky Star!) from your hand and/or GY (their effects on field are negated, which you immediately bypass by using them with Polymerization or Super Polymerization into Idaten or Raijin—and once Idaten modifies its ATK, Kaiki revives itself from the GY on the opponent's turn with its Fusion effect fully active!)!
allow.Keeper of Dragon Magic: Searches Polymerization or Super Polymerization on Normal/Special Summon to fuse your Level 5 Star Warriors into Idaten the Conqueror Star.
allow.Polymerization: Fuses any 2 Level 5+ Warriors (Hayate, Tenma, or Kaiki) into Idaten the Conqueror Star (which searches a Level 5 Warrior on Fusion Summon!) or Raijin the Breakbolt Star.
allow.Super Polymerization: Fuses an opponent's Warrior/LIGHT/DARK monster or fuses your own Idaten + a Level 5+ Warrior during the Battle Phase into Shura the Combat Star!
allow.King of the Swamp: Discards itself to add 'Polymerization' from your Deck to your hand, OR substitutes for the named Fusion Material 'Idaten the Conqueror Star' to Fusion Summon Level 12 Shura the Combat Star!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends 'Kaiki the Unity Star' directly from your Deck to the GY—so the moment Idaten the Conqueror Star (+200 ATK) or Hayate (-500 ATK) changes its ATK, Kaiki can revive itself during your opponent's turn and Fusion Summon Shura the Combat Star!
allow.Gilti-Gearfried the Magical Steel Knight: Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Fusion ('2 Warrior monsters with different Attributes': Level 5 EARTH Hayate + Level 5 LIGHT Tenma/Kaiki!) that can be Fusion Summoned by Kaiki the Unity Star!
allow.Constellar Pleiades: Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (2 Level 5 LIGHT monsters: Tenma the Sky Star + Kaiki the Unity Star) that bounces a card on the field as a Quick Effect.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters you control by 500 ATK—which IMMEDIATELY fulfills Kaiki the Unity Star's GY revival condition ('if you control a Level 5 or higher Warrior monster whose current ATK is different from its original ATK') for every single Star Warrior on your board!

main: Core Level 5 LIGHT Warrior engine: if this card is Special Summoned, you can pay 500 LP to Fusion Summon 1 Warrior Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using monsters from your hand or field; and during your opponent's turn, if this card is in your GY and you control a Level 5+ Warrior whose current ATK is different from its original ATK (Quick Effect), Special Summons itself from your GY (and immediately triggers its Fusion Summon effect on the opponent's turn!)!

Core Level 5 EARTH Warrior starter (2100 ATK): if only your opponent controls a monster, OR if you control a LIGHT monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing; when Normal or Special Summoned, Special Summons 1 Level 5 LIGHT Warrior ('Tenma the Sky Star' or 'Kaiki the Unity Star'!) from your hand; and loses 500 ATK to negate an attack (changing its current ATK to turn on Kaiki in the GY!)!

Core Level 5 LIGHT Warrior starter (2100 ATK): if only your opponent controls a monster, OR if you control an EARTH monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing; when Normal or Special Summoned, Special Summons 1 Level 5 EARTH Warrior ('Hayate the Earth Star'!) from your hand; and loses 500 ATK as a Quick Effect to negate and destroy any opponent's effect that targets your Warrior (also turning on Kaiki in the GY!)!
Discards itself to search 'Polymerization', OR substitutes for 'Idaten the Conqueror Star' to Fusion Summon Level 12 Shura the Combat Star.
Discards 1 card (like Kaiki the Unity Star!) on Normal or Special Summon to search 'Polymerization' or 'Super Polymerization' from your Deck.
Fuses any 2 of Hayate, Tenma, and Kaiki into Idaten the Conqueror Star or Raijin the Breakbolt Star.
Special Summons up to 2 Level 5 Warrior monsters (Hayate, Tenma, or Kaiki) from your hand and/or GY to provide instant Fusion, Xyz, or Link materials.
Quick-Play Fusion Spell that fuses Idaten + a Level 5+ Warrior during the Battle Phase into Shura the Combat Star for an OTK.
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Kaiki the Unity Star directly from your Deck to the GY so it can revive itself on the opponent's turn and Fusion Summon.
extra: Signature Level 10 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss (2 Level 5 or higher Warrior monsters; 3000 ATK): when Fusion Summoned, adds ANY Level 5 Warrior monster (Kaiki, Hayate, or Tenma!) from your Deck to your hand; once per turn discards any number of cards to gain 200 ATK each (changing its current ATK so Kaiki the Unity Star in the GY is immediately live!); and reduces any battling monster with an equal or lower Level to 0 ATK during damage calculation!

Signature Level 12 DARK Warrior Fusion boss ('Idaten the Conqueror Star' + 1 Level 5 or higher Warrior monster): once per turn during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect), reduces the ATK of ALL face-up monsters your opponent currently controls to 0; when a Warrior battles, both battling Warriors gain ATK equal to their Level x 200 (+2400 ATK to Level 12 Shura!); and floats into a Fusion Summoned Idaten the Conqueror Star if destroyed!

Signature Level 10 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss (1 Level 5+ LIGHT Warrior + 1 EARTH Warrior; 3000 ATK): inflicts piercing battle damage when attacking a Defense Position monster, inflicts DOUBLE battle damage when battling a monster without a Level (Xyz and Link Monsters!), and revives itself from the GY during the End Phase if destroyed!
Level 8 LIGHT Warrior Fusion (2 Warriors with different Attributes: EARTH Hayate + LIGHT Tenma/Kaiki) that gains 500 ATK (turning on Kaiki in the GY!) and attacks twice.

Link-2 FIRE Warrior (2 monsters with different names): gives all Warrior monsters on the field +500 ATK—which continuously modifies the ATK of every Level 5+ Warrior you control so Kaiki the Unity Star can ALWAYS revive itself from your GY on the opponent's turn!
Rank 5 LIGHT Warrior Xyz (Tenma + Kaiki) for Quick Effect bounce disruption.
